e.title: Parametric Insurance Demo (Microsoft)
e.summary: 微软官方参数险理赔 Demo（MIT，Fabric 笔记本）：停电营业中断险的 AI 自动理赔
e.body: Parametric Insurance Demo 是微软官方参数险演示（MIT，Python 3.11+）：用电营业中断（power outage business interruption）参数险的 AI 自动理赔处理——完全运行在 Microsoft Fabric 笔记本上。参数险（按触发指数自动赔付）是新险种趋势，此演示展示端到端理赔自动化。对 RIAA：参数险产品与理赔自动化的官方工程范式。与 [[cascsim]]（CAS 理赔模拟）、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]（核保 agent）、[[claimpilot-harness]] 互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[parametric-insurance]]（概念）、[[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：微软（kalateefMSFT）参数险理赔 Demo，MIT，Microsoft Fabric 笔记本，停电营业中断险 AI 自动理赔
e.summary_en: Official Microsoft parametric-insurance claims demo (MIT, Fabric notebooks): AI-powered automatic claims processing for power-outage business interruption
e.summary_hk: 微軟官方參數險理賠 Demo（MIT，Fabric 筆記本）：停電營業中斷險的 AI 自動理賠
e.body_en: Parametric Insurance Demo is an official Microsoft parametric-insurance demo (MIT, Python 3.11+): AI-powered automatic claims processing for power-outage business-interruption parametric insurance — running entirely from Microsoft Fabric notebooks. Parametric insurance (automatic payout on a trigger index) is an emerging product trend; this demo shows end-to-end claims automation. For RIAA: the official engineering pattern for parametric products and claims automation. Complements [[cascsim]] (CAS claims simulation), [[agentic-bop-underwriting]] (underwriting agent) and [[claimpilot-harness]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]].
e.body_hk: Parametric Insurance Demo 是微軟官方參數險演示（MIT，Python 3.11+）：用電營業中斷（power outage business interruption）參數險的 AI 自動理賠處理——完全運行在 Microsoft Fabric 筆記本上。參數險（按觸發指數自動賠付）是新險種趨勢，此演示展示端到端理賠自動化。對 RIAA：參數險產品與理賠自動化的官方工程範式。與 [[cascsim]]（CAS 理賠模擬）、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]（核保 agent）、[[claimpilot-harness]] 互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]]。
